reviews.title: So helpful
reviews.text: This is the easiest app I’ve found to start documenting fibromyalgia.  I need record of everything, I need to find a pattern of flare up so I can understand what I’m going through and this app is amazing

reviews.title: So helpful
reviews.text:
This app really helps me understand my triggers and the patterns that affect my mental health. I think the level of tracking it provides (for free) provides incredible insight into why I feel the way I do. I also like that I can schedule reminders, since I forget to do this kind of stuff.

Edit: I was just gifted a free subscription thanks to the heroes program! I’m really looking forward to see what else I can learn. These metrics are super customizable, so I really feel like it helps.

reviews.title: Decent tracker
reviews.text: Im still learning how to read the reports and everything. My main concern is that my doctor uses a 1-10 scale for symptoms so trying to translate my past experiences from bearable’s 0-4 scale can be difficult. The free version is decent enough considering not many trackers even have free versions anymore

reviews.title: It’s good and free
reviews.text: I love how I can do this and it will be free some apps you have to pay

reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.text: I have several chronic illnesses, and it’s nice to have a way to record what is going on so I can use it for reference. It is also good to know when I took my medicines. I really like it so far, and it’s very easy to use.

reviews.title: Super Helpful
reviews.text: Been learning how to manage my symptoms and notice triggers within my body. I’m only a week in and feel like I learned a lot!

reviews.title: Pain Tracking App Doesn’t Allow You To Look At Past Entries
reviews.text: I think it is counterintuitive to record your pain but you can’t go back and see the records you have been keeping without paying $30 a month? Especially if you are a chronically ill person who doesn’t make much money.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: After updating my data for over a year, all my data is lost because of an incorrect login. I have emailed the variable team anytime to request that my database synced so I don’t lose a year worth of data. As you can imagine it is hard enough living with a chronic illness, but do not have access to your medical data is defeating and exhausting. Very sad and disappointed, and the way this has been handled (or not) by the Bearable team.

reviews.title: Extremely Helpful!
reviews.text: I found this app thanks to a Google search/Reddit recommendation and I absolutely LOVE it! I have multiple chronic and acute health issues that are difficult to keep track of and report to my doctors, but this app makes it 100x easier to have a log of everything. It has just about everything you need in the free-to-use features, so you won’t feel forced to pay for premium like with some apps. Definitely recommend giving it a try if you have chronic illnesses you’d like to keep track of!

reviews.title: Takes out the guesswork
reviews.text:
I have been dealing with digestive issues all year and had been told that I need to keep a food diary, but I found it so hard to remember to do. This app has come in so handy because I always have my phone on me and it helps me to create a habit of checking in after every meal, bathroom trip, med taken, etc. it tracks so much and so many different aspects that I don’t have to think about all the little details on my own. 

It also helps that there is a little bear that helps me along. I don’t want to disappoint my bear! I would recommend this app if you are trying to find food and environmental triggers to health issues!

reviews.title: Bearable is super helpful
reviews.text: just had a doctor call the other day and it helped me organize my thoughts so much. helped me to remember my symptoms and things like that and has been a life saver for me!!

reviews.title: Get this app
reviews.text: My life got easier when I got this.it helps me track everything I do and eat

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I am actually able tomboy only see my health triggers but track my symptoms this helps so much for doctor visits.

reviews.title: Unexplained chronic problems
reviews.text: Downloaded this app to find correlations between my behavior and my symptoms. And that’s what it does! With a great UI too. The variety of options can be hidden but it encourages me to check in with my body which is hard when I’m in pain. I find it really well suited to my needs

reviews.title: Must have tracker
reviews.text: I’m trying to diagnose the root causes of several debilitating symptoms. This app allows me to track everything and to customize as needed. The app is easy to use and the insights have been extremely helpful.

reviews.title: Really useful app
reviews.text: I am not a data person nor am I very routine oriented, so this app has been a lifesaver for me. It is easy to use, easy to customize & allows me to track  what I need to without being pushy. The softness of the presentation makes me want to engage & makes me curious about my functioning rather than stressed about my lack thereof at times. I highly recommend this app for anyone trying to track their struggles AND wellness. It has all the bells & whistles for data junkies, but space for those who just need a way to track symptoms to share with our health providers.

reviews.title: Seriously lacking
reviews.text: This app is seriously lacking. It seems more invasive than helpful. It doesn’t let you track things through out the day in an organized timely way. It just groups things and basically is fishing for info on things that they sell and use for their profit. The person who created this doesn’t care about the people using this.

reviews.title: Just starting out trying this
reviews.text: Can you fix the overlap, can’t read the whole screen, bottom is cut off by the NEXT button.

reviews.title: Love this App!
reviews.text: I appreciate the effort put into this app and it really shows in its interface. Thank you!

reviews.title: Confusing
reviews.text: I can’t see anything in my profile, edit goals, or sync with Apple health. FAQ s are no help.

reviews.title: Updated now that I’ve used it more
reviews.text: I wrote an earlier review about not finding the app super useful yet, and I’m updating to say I don’t think previously I had given it enough time. You do have to be regular with the daily check ins and adding in your meds and supplements, symptoms etc. I’ve been using now for a full week and starting to see helpful trends and insights, and the check ins themselves are good reminders to be intentional about my time and energy. Would like to see more check ins available during the day like I previously wrote. But overall, and especially considering how affordable this app is, it’s a great tool.

reviews.title: Great helper
reviews.text: Bearable helps me not only keep track of my personal care metrics, it is customizable to my specific needs, making it an invaluable tool in leading a healthy lifestyle.

reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.text: This is exactly the kind of app I wanted and I’m so glad I found it. I’m a data nerd and wanted to track how different things were effecting my mental and physical health and this does just that.

reviews.title: Grateful
reviews.text: I was tracking my health for some severe health problems. It turns out that I have a brain tumor. More than ever, I am grateful to have an app that’s easy to use, to track my health symptoms. I’m able to get to know myself and my triggers better. It’s also helping me be aware of what to communicate to my medical team.

reviews.title: Helpful App
reviews.text: Finding this app has been incredibly helpful for tracking health information. I cannot recommend it enough. I greatly appreciate that the app is usable as the free version.

reviews.title: So much more
reviews.text: Bearable has been amazing at helping me track and figure out correlations between symptoms and triggers. It has made it so much easier to communicate what is happening in real time to my DRs. It has so much more than I ever expected it to be. If you’re debating whether or not to use it, just do it! It’s so worth it

reviews.title: Easy to keep up with
reviews.text: I’ve tried a lot of tracker apps, and I’ve been able to keep up with bearable most days. I have adhd, so there’s the irony of constantly downloading tracking apps just to delete them. I think with bearable, however, I find the UX to be friendly and I like how easy it is to customize. I’m still getting a hang of what factors and symptoms I want to keep track of, but so far I’m enjoying it and found the app to be simple yet affective 🥰

reviews.title: Reads data doesn’t write
reviews.text: The marketing makes it sound integrated with Apple Health, but in reality it mainly pulls data from Apple Health rather than contributing useful symptom and pain data back to it. If you're an iPhone user trying to keep all health information centralized in Apple Health, this app falls short. Without two-way integration, I don't see much value compared to alternatives that actually write health data back into the Apple ecosystem.

reviews.title: Extremely useful App
reviews.text:
I used Bearable in the past but didn't keep it up and kept forgetting, this is normal for me. I have all the common problems: Bipolar 1, depression,
ADHD, anxiety disorder, heart disease, blood clotting disorder, etc.

But since January I have been having symptoms that don't fit with those. I started trying to keep up with them, but kept forgetting. AND THEN, I remembered BEARABLE.

Being able to add any symptoms I'm having has made a huge difference!! I have a record to show the doctor. She was amazed. I had dates, timelines, symptoms, and everything that was different than usual, like I forgot to eat, how many trips to the ladies room, what I ate, my mood and as many as you need to add for your particular situation. The doctor ordered a MRI and appropriate blood test. I found out that I don't have what I thought but I was heard by my doctor.

Bear is easy to setup and use, even a reminder so you don't forget. It's worth getting and using.
The reports tell you and your doctor how you are doing.

reviews.title: Very useful!
reviews.text: This app is super useful for tracking symptoms and what impacts them! Super comprehensive but not overwhelming, and very customizable so you can easily tailor it to your specific needs!

reviews.title: So far…
reviews.text: So good…

reviews.title: Great for chronic health management
reviews.text: Really love this app, helped me track my health throughout a chronic illness flare, helped me see what helped me get better through its health factors feature. 100% recommend

reviews.title: Helpful for Spoonies
reviews.text: I was looking for a “spoonie” app and this app is perfect for what I was searching for! It actually offers more than I was looking for, which is great!

reviews.title: Great but buggy
reviews.text: Of all the apps I've used for mood tracking, this one is the best. It's comprehensive but not overly complicated, you can add and remove things you want to track, and you can set multiple reminders. I would give it 5 stars if you were allowed to report a problem, and I am having one- this app does not give reminders consistently. That part is frustrating and I haven't found a way to report it as a problem since the only options offered are to report abuse or request a refund.

reviews.title: Extremely annoyed
reviews.text: idk what the hell happened but after using this app for two years i have a lot of customizations and such｡ all of the sudden i open the app this morning and they're  all gone ??? all the additional physical pain symptoms i added and have been tracking for years is just gone and my data for those, i have to add them back AND lost years of tracking for those symptoms｡ i am extremely extremely annoyed i almost don't even want to use this app anymore for that

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Its a cool app other than needing premium for the majority of important things like longtime tracking. But other than that it offers a ton without the need of premium which is completely fair. Overall its a pretty nice app

reviews.title: Helpful App
reviews.text: This app is a great way to track your symptoms.

reviews.title: Works well beyond what I expected… only a little I would change
reviews.text:
The app works really well for the price.  I have been logging for over two weeks and can already see trends that will help
Me when I need to see medics professionals and have evidence to back up what I am feeling/experiencing.  The way that you enter the information can be a little counterintuitive but you can go back to edit the times of when something happened ( took meds, have a symptom, pain score etc). The app also coordinates with the apple health app and TachyMon… which is a huge help in being able to provide symptoms, HR, steps etc without having to log that information yourself. 

So far…I am fining it far more helpful
Than almost any other app and using the trends option is helping me narrow down what I need to be looking for for triggers and how to pace myself.

reviews.title: I love this app!
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for over 2 years. I highly recommend it and even the free version is useful!! I recommend this app to all of my friends! I struggle with my mental health and this app has truly helped me a lot!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Wow, I will tell you I was really impressed. It showed me an alert that my heart rate had gone down to 46 bpm.  I would have never known one without this program. I’ve only had this program for less than a month.

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: Thank you to the makes of this app as it's helping many individuals like myself!

reviews.title: Time consuming for little data feedback
reviews.text:
I've been using this app for two years, as a paid user for the first year. I initially started using it to test it out for someone with chronic health conditions who is taking about 30 medications per day. I've been using it to track my own medical conditions and mental health.

This app causes me more anxiety just to use it. It requires me to fill out dozens and dozens of symptoms at different ratings twice a day. That would be perfectly OK if I felt that I was getting good or even average interpreted information on the app that explained correlations of my symptoms. Hopefully that would in turn, allow me to know when I will have a flareup or know what factors to avoid that lead to increased symptoms.

My entire purpose of using the app is to hopefully understand how some of my symptoms correlate and to be able to reduce their severity. In terms of using it to track mental health symptoms, it's even more depressing to get through with a tough day and have an app that gives you absolutely no coping mechanism or positive messages for solutions to any of the symptoms that you're going through. Understandably, it is a tracking app and not a treatment app. 

The app has a lot of great customizability and features, however for my uses I have concluded after two years that it is not worth my time and I will return to my previous methods. My friend didn't end up downloading it either because they were not interested in having to fill out so much information every day.

reviews.title: Love this app!!
reviews.text: I have a chronic illness and this app has been amazing tracking my mood, symptoms and meds. The only thing I wish it had was a place to record injection sites. Other than that it’s an absolute 10 out of 10!!

reviews.title: Truly Useful!!
reviews.text: Finally a method to (besides keeping countless notebooks & multiple apps) for tracking symptoms & details (w/o knowing the concept why are we tracking them?), across multiple different conditions which is essential for people who live with complicated/rare & chronic conditions. Finally an app that goes beyond just tracking basic mood or meds, or activity but not only tracks all of these things, as well as nutrition, but also a very important & detailed physical pain/symptom tracker all of which allow customizable notes for adding details/context which is imperative for understanding what’s actually going on. Without context, everything else really is just a bunch of numbers left for any amount of speculative analysis to be drawn from.

reviews.title: Doesn’t sync completely with Apple Health
reviews.text:
The app is a decent symptom tracker, with a generally great User Interface.

Unfortunately, because only some metrics sync with apple health, this results in users having to manually input several metrics, manually copy pasting apple watch values from apple health (i.e. blood oxygen saturation).

Makes the friction to using this app so much higher. What a shame. Would have recommended to all my patients otherwise.

I guess we’ll have to wait and see if they bother improving the user experience.

reviews.title: The Best Health Tracking App I’ve Found
reviews.text:
I’ve tried a lot of health tracking apps over the years, and Bearable is by far my favorite. As someone living with multiple chronic illnesses, it’s incredibly helpful to have one place to track symptoms, pain, sleep, medications, mood, energy, vitals, and so much more.

What really sets Bearable apart is its flexibility. You can customize almost everything to fit your own health conditions and daily routine. I also love the insights feature, which helps identify patterns and possible triggers that I might never have noticed on my own. Those reports have been useful not only for me but also when discussing my health with my doctors.

The developers are constantly improving the app and genuinely listen to feedback from the community. If you’re looking for a powerful, customizable health tracker that can grow with your needs, I highly recommend Bearable. It’s become an essential part of managing my health. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: I have so many symptoms, but I had no idea exactly how many until this app… this helps me so much! So detailed and easy to use…

reviews.title: Worth it for chemo patients
reviews.text: My oncologists recommended a “quality of life” journal. It was too tricky to track with paper and pen. The app developers have done a great job considering what someone with chronic illness or undergoing chemo might need to track. There are more than enough baseline tracking points, but also flexibility to create your own tracking points for data that matters to you.

reviews.title: The Health Tool Of A Lifetime
reviews.text: This app is amazing for quickly tracking your health symptoms and offers so many more options such as medication tracking. I love how customizable this app is to each individual. The only suggestion I would make so far is to allow users to add in their own medication list as some medications are not available to document. GET THIS APP!!! You do not have to pay a dime to use it for free and the functions are still extremely useful!

reviews.title: Bearable is bearable
reviews.text: The bear has not yet offended me 🐻‍❄️❤️
